# Vitesse Energy Declares $0.4375 Quarterly Cash Dividend


October 28, 2026 4:06pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_988fefdff5e090956a39f190dff19e5b/vitesseoil/news/2026-10-28_Vitesse_Energy_Declares_0_4375_Quarterly_Cash_59.pdf)


GREENWOOD VILLAGE, Colo.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Vitesse Energy, Inc. (NYSE: VTS) (“Vitesse”) today announced that its Board of Directors declared its fourth quarter cash dividend of $0.4375 per share on its common stock, payable December 31, 2026, to stockholders of record as of December 15, 2026.


**ABOUT VITESSE ENERGY, INC.**


Vitesse Energy, Inc. is focused on returning capital to stockholders through owning financial interests predominantly as a non-operator in oil and gas wells drilled by leading U.S. operators.


More information about Vitesse can be found at[www.vitesse-vts.com](https://www.vitesse-vts.com/) .
